title_sq: Shitet Apartament 1+1 tek Zgjatimi i Rezidences Kodra e Diellit 1
description_sq:
• Shitet Apartament 1+1 tek Zgjerimi i Rezidences Kodra e Diellit 1, prane British School. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e pare te nje objekti 6 katesh, i ndertuar ne vitin 2018. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne nje kordior qe shperndan ambjentet, ambjenti i ndenjes, dhoma e gjumi, tualeti dhe nje oborr. 
• Apartamenti eshte i investuar, i pershtatshem per banim / investim, pasi qirate ne Rezidence variojn 500€ - 550€ ne muaj. Zona eshte e qete, e mireadministruar dhe ofron parkim per banoret Rezident. Prona disponon Certifikate Pronesie, shitet dhe me kredi. Per nje vizite me kontaktoni !
title_en: 1+1 Apartment for sale in Kodra e Diellit Residence Extension 1
description_en: • 1+1 Apartment for sale in Kodra e Diellit Residence Extension 1, near the British School. The apartment is located on the first floor of a 6-storey building, built in 2018. The apartment is organized in a corridor that divides the premises, the living room, the bedroom, the toilet and a yard. • The apartment is invested, suitable for residence / investment, as rents in the Residence range from €500 - €550 per month. The area is quiet, well managed and offers parking for residents. The property has Certificates of Ownership, it is also sold on credit. Contact me for a visit!
